;
        ORG     #8000
;
        DEFMAC  MOVE
        LD      HL,/0
        LD      DE,/1
        LD      BC,/2
        LDIR
        ENDMAC
;
        DEFMAC  HL*8
;
        ADD     HL,HL
        ADD     HL,HL
        ADD     HL,HL
        JP      ...1
...1
;
        ENDMAC
;
        DEFMAC  HL*16
        ADD     HL,HL
        ADD     HL,HL
        ADD     HL,HL
        ADD     HL,HL
        JR      ...1
...1
        ENDMAC
;
        .LOCAL
        LD      B,0
...1
        DEC     B
        JP      NZ,...1
;
        LD      HL,10
        HL*8
        DISPLAY ...1
        .LOCAL
        LD      C,0
...1
        DEC     C
        JP      NZ,...1
;
        LD      HL,4
        HL*16
        DISPLAY ...1
        LD      HL,0
        HL*8
        DISPLAY ...1
        MOVE    0,16384,6144
        RET
